get.summary: Platform numbers: users, teachers, registrations, published sites.
Search accounts by email (or id), status and platform role; 20 per page, newest first.

post.summary: Suspend an account (reason required): sessions end, sign-in is refused, the public site is hidden.
Platform Owner only, with a fresh authenticator code.
Platform Owner only, with a fresh authenticator code.

get.summary: Audit entries, newest first, filtered by action prefix, user (actor or target), workspace and UTC days.
Active subject categories, subjects, education levels and teaching languages (mk/en names).

post.summary: Add a category, subject or level (the code is permanent).

put.summary: Rename, reorder, activate or deactivate (entries are never deleted).

get.summary: Leads, tests, page visits, offers, onboarding and the conversion funnel for the last 7, 30 or 90 days.
Lessons of the next 7 days, active students, what students owe, lessons left in packages and payments received per month.
A published test with its questions and options (never the correct answers).

post.summary: Submit the chosen options; the server scores them and returns the totals and an attempt id for an optional contact request.
Create a draft test with its questions and options. 409 TEST_SLUG_TAKEN for a used address.

get.summary: The whole test including the correct options (teacher only).

put.summary: Replace the test (questions keep their ids). 409 on a stale version; 409 TEST_HAS_ATTEMPTS for destructive edits after attempts (D-38).

delete.summary: Archive: hidden from the list and the public; attempts and the address are kept.

post.summary: Publish after the checks: a question, two options and a correct answer each, points. 400 lists what is missing.
An editable draft copy with new ids and no attempts (D-38: "duplicate as new version").

get.summary: How often the test was taken, and the results visitors shared with their contact request.
Every student with finance records: what they owe per currency, lessons left and unpaid lessons.
A period (local days, at most a year): packages sold, charged and received per currency, lessons consumed.
Balances per currency, packages and one page of the history (newest first).

post.summary: From an offer (its terms are copied) or custom; later offer changes never alter the package.

get.summary: Active (or archived) groups by name; optionally only those a student is a member of.

delete.summary: End the membership; the record stays for the lesson history.

get.summary: Homework (active or archived), newest change first, with the number of assigned, submitted and reviewed students; optionally of one lesson.

delete.summary: Only while the student has not answered.

post.summary: Answer with text and/or a file (PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX or TXT, at most 20 MB); allowed until reviewed.

get.summary: Issue an antiforgery request token (also in the X-XSRF-TOKEN response header).

post.summary: Create a teacher account. Always answers 202 (no account enumeration).
Sign in. 200: signed in. 202: the account uses the authenticator; finish with /login/two-factor.
Second sign-in step: an authenticator code or a recovery code.

patch.summary: Update the account's language and time zone.

post.summary: Create a new authenticator key (shown once). Replacing an enabled one needs a current code or a recovery code.
Confirm the key with a code from the app; returns the recovery codes (shown once).
Replace the recovery codes (needs a fresh authenticator code).

get.summary: Contact form data of a published site: availability, a signed form token, offers, subjects and the consent text.

post.summary: Send a message or lesson request to the teacher. Always 202 without echoing data; spam is dropped silently.

get.summary: The inbox, newest first: filter by status, type, text (name, email, message) and archived.

put.summary: New → Contacted → Converted, close at any point, reopen a closed lead. 422 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION; 409 stale version.

get.summary: The signed-in student's next lessons, most recent past lessons (attendance, shared summary) and attendance counts.
Lessons starting on the local days from..to (inclusive, workspace time zone, at most 62 days).

post.summary: Schedule a lesson; 409 LESSON_OVERLAP when the teacher already has a lesson at that time.
Mark as held with attendance (left out: Present). Idempotent: a held lesson is returned as it is.

get.summary: A student's or a group's lessons, newest first.

post.summary: Set up weekly or bi-weekly lessons; occurrences are created 12 weeks ahead and conflicts are reported per occurrence.

put.summary: Change this and the following lessons, or all future ones (D-24); a new series continues.

post.summary: Creates the student (if needed) and the lesson after a conflict check; 409 LESSON_OVERLAP leaves it pending.

get.summary: Materials (active or archived), newest change first; with the storage the workspace uses.

post.summary: Upload a material (PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX or TXT, at most 20 MB); counts towards the plan storage.
Delete the material, its assignments and its file (frees the storage).

get.summary: Only a material assigned to the student or to one of their groups; anything else is 404.

post.summary: Report content of a public page: the site, a section or a test. Always 202 once the content exists.

get.summary: The moderation queue, newest first; filter by status (Open, Resolved, Dismissed).

post.summary: Hide the reported content with a reason (shown to the teacher); resolves every open report about it.
Show hidden content again, with a reason (audited; the teacher is told).

get.summary: The optional notifications (lesson reminders, new homework) of the signed-in user; on unless switched off.

delete.summary: Archive the offer (hidden, never bookable again; history is kept).

get.summary: The site draft, or suggestions to start from when it does not exist yet (exists = false).

put.summary: Save the draft (slug, template, palette, language, sections). Visitors see the draft only after publishing.

post.summary: Publish the saved draft at /{slug}. 422 SITE_NOT_CREATED before the first save; 409 when the version is stale.
Take the public page offline (404). The draft is kept.
A signed preview URL for the current draft, valid for 15 minutes.

get.summary: Active (or archived) students, by name; search by name, email, phone or guardian.

post.summary: Add a student (no login needed). The email must be unique among your students; the Free plan limits active students.
D-12: link the request to the student with the same email, or create one; idempotent.

get.summary: The teacher's private notes, newest first. Never part of any student-facing response.

post.summary: Email the student a 7-day, single-use link to their own account; replaces a pending invitation.

delete.summary: End the student's access with their account (the account itself stays).

post.summary: Link the signed-in account to the invited student.
Create an account for the invited email, link it and sign in.

get.summary: The teachers the signed-in user is an active student of (D-16).
The workspace's plan, its limits and what is in use. Teachers cannot change it (platform staff do).

put.summary: Platform Owner only (D-39): new values for every limit of the plan.

post.summary: Activate Pro for N months, or extend an active Pro period from its end, recording the payment (D-30).

put.summary: Upload the profile photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB, at least 128 × 128). Stored re-encoded as WebP without metadata.

get.summary: Onboarding checklist derived from the workspace's data (never ticked manually).
